proposedSupersedes.reason: No provider calls occurred. This V4 candidate proposes to supersede V3 only after the Qwen endpoint and data-region owner decision, complete root recomputation, frozen-candidate validation, and independent review.

scope.estimandLimitation: Inference applies only to the provider-egress-eligible subset of the frozen California runtime-visible frame.

runtimePopulation.questionStoreContract: lib/server/questionStore.ts runtime filtering, deduplication, profile, feature-state, and public-projection semantics

publicProtectedFrameSeparation.protectedArtifact: RuntimeExtractionSnapshotV1 with source receipt, IDs, leaves, failure detail, and source-exclusion detail
publicProtectedFrameSeparation.trackedPublicArtifact: FrameRegistrationV2 with aggregate counts/distributions, completion timestamps, and cryptographic roots only

inclusion: Item serializes under the frozen canonical JSON schema.
Response form is multiple-choice, fill-in, or short-answer.
Prompt contains enough content for mathematical review.
Egress screen confirms no personal data, secrets, internal paths, or unauthorized restricted content.
exclusion: Not visible under the frozen runtime configuration.
PII, credential, internal path, or restricted egress content.
Unstable serialization or a read crash.

allocation.baseRule: base_i=min(2,capacity_i); capacity-one cells are legal and receive one
allocation.weights: original eligible independent cluster counts in uniquely assigned cells
allocation.residualRule: cap extras at residual capacity and repeatedly redistribute overflow using original weights
allocation.arithmetic: exact integer numerator/denominator and cross-multiplied remainder comparisons

homologyClustering.representation: template skeleton with case-folding, whitespace collapse, numeric literal slots, and option-order normalization

deterministicSelection.byteSerialization: UTF-8 RFC8785-JCS encoding of the ordered six-element string array [designHash,frameHash,algorithmVersion,stratum,clusterId,itemHash]; frameHash is the timestamp-excluded frameSelectionContentRootHash, and no field-level delimiter restriction is introduced

digestContract.designHashSemantic: designHash is the frozen design registrationHash
digestContract.frameHashSemantic: frameHash is the timestamp-excluded frameSelectionContentRootHash; it is not samplingFrameHash and not frameRegistrationHash

algorithmDescriptor.selectionDesignHashSemantic: designHash is the frozen design registrationHash
algorithmDescriptor.selectionFrameHashSemantic: frameHash is the timestamp-excluded frameSelectionContentRootHash; it is not samplingFrameHash and not frameRegistrationHash

deterministicSelection.crossCellClusterOwnership: Compute each eligible member digest; lowest digest, then lexicographic itemId, is the sole representative and assigns the whole cluster to that member's one stratum.
deterministicSelection.hamiltonEligibleCounts: Count each cluster exactly once in its assigned stratum.
deterministicSelection.withinStratumOrdering: ascending selectionDigest then lexicographic itemId; select at most one item per cluster
deterministicSelection.itemInclusionProbability: clusterInclusionProbability multiplied by deterministicRepresentativeIndicator; nonrepresentatives have probability zero for this execution version
deterministicSelection.secondaryAnalysisWeight: inverse cluster inclusion probability; descriptive only with Kish effective sample size
deterministicSelection.replacementAuthorityHistoryRootFormula: SHA256(JCS(exact full replacementHistory array in append order))
deterministicSelection.preResultReplacementRule: Before the first provider call only: registered RESTRICTED_EGRESS_CONTENT or UNSTABLE_SERIALIZATION exclusion, exact next-ranked item, new sample version, non-null supersedes root, and no reroll; all post-result replacement is forbidden.

machineReferenceWorkflow.separation: The final machine-reference panel label is sealed before any DeepSeek evaluated output; raw A and B labels are mutually blinded and the adjudicator sees only this item plus A/B solve and label receipts.
machineReferenceWorkflow.agreementMergeRule: Local DETERMINISTIC_MERGER with providerCall=false and no adjudication receipt only when every A/B field including stable finding leaves exactly agrees, neither is uncertain, and neither contains P0 or P1.
machineReferenceWorkflow.adjudicationRule: Any field disagreement, uncertainty, P0, or P1 requires exactly one successful Qwen ADJUDICATOR attempt; no best-of-N and no sixth/reference follow-up call.

taxonomy.acceptedCodeSetFormula: For every metric-eligible primary defect code, including FALSE_ACCEPT_CORRECT_RESPONSE: sort([primaryCode]); exactly one code; same frozen family; status codes are ineligible.

labeling.adjudication: The Qwen ADJUDICATOR sees only this item and sealed A/B solve and raw-label receipts, never DeepSeek output.
labeling.falseAcceptCorrectResponseRule: FALSE_ACCEPT_CORRECT_RESPONSE is a formal P0; any raw occurrence triggers adjudication under ANY_RATER_P0 and the adjudicator may retain it as a metric-eligible final P0 defect.
labeling.unresolvedRule: SCHEMA_GAP or adjudicator undecided is UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE; no imputation; the one unified missing-receipt, unresolved-reference, and invalid-item universe has maximum 3 of 60.

denominatorPolicy.surfaceSensitivity: reference-positive resolved items; missing and unresolved enter worst-case decision bound
denominatorPolicy.surfaceSpecificityAndFpr: reference-negative resolved items; missing and unresolved enter worst-case decision bound
denominatorPolicy.findingRecall: stable reference finding leaves keyed by itemId+findingId+family+code; status codes excluded; multiple independent same-code findings remain distinct
denominatorPolicy.findingPrecision: stable machine finding leaves keyed by itemId+findingId+family+code; status codes excluded; descriptive only
denominatorPolicy.falseFindingsPer100: unmatched metric-eligible machine findings / all 60 registered items * 100; descriptive only
denominatorPolicy.p2MissedOrUnresolved: metric-eligible P2 reference opportunities, with unresolved counted adverse
denominatorPolicy.unifiedNonresolvedUniverse: missing receipt items + unresolved reference items + invalid items; one shared item universe, maximum 3, never complete-case deletion
denominatorPolicy.rawAgreement: all 60 paired A/B raw item labels
denominatorPolicy.adjudicationRate: items sent to adjudication / all 60 items

confidenceIntervals.bootstrapPrng: Counter-based SHA-256 over registrationHash|metric|replicate|draw|rejection; first 64-bit big-endian integer below 2^64-(2^64 mod bound), then integer modulo bound
confidenceIntervals.minimumMetricCombination: min(Wilson LCB, bootstrap 5th percentile, worst-case-missing LCB)
confidenceIntervals.maximumErrorMetricCombination: max(Wilson UCB, bootstrap 95th percentile, worst-case-missing UCB)

missingData.unifiedNonresolvedUniverseIdentity: completeReceiptItemCount + missingReceiptItemCount = 60; complete items classified UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE or INVALID consume the same three-item allowance and never create an additional allowance
missingData.itemMetricRule: PRODUCT(per-item cardinality) across the unified nonresolved universe: resolved reference plus machine nonresolution has cardinality 2; unresolved or invalid reference has cardinality 2 when the machine is resolved and 4 when the machine is nonresolved. At the limit of three items the maximum 64 is exhaustive. Recompute the one-sided 95 percent Wilson interval in every feasible world and take the conservative bound.
missingData.findingMetricRule: Use sealed resolved-reference finding counts with machine-side adverse assignment. If any reference finding set is unresolved or invalid, the finding estimand is unidentified with decision bound [0,1] and metric status UNDERPOWERED; do not fabricate finite per-item finding caps from the taxonomy size.
missingData.integrityLimitExceededCounterfactualDisp: DO_NOT_ENUMERATE; EMIT EMPTY SURFACE WORLD SET AND EXECUTION_INTEGRITY_FAILED EVIDENCE
missingData.p0MissingRule: P0 decision is observed false negatives only; missing opportunities are not fabricated as observed P0 false negatives.

deepSeekEnvelope.c0PrimeReducerDuplicateRule: UNIQUE_ITEM_FINDING_ID_FAMILY_CODE_WITH_NONEMPTY_EVIDENCE_LOCATOR; exact cross-role duplicate deduplicates; same findingId with conflicting projection is unresolved

c0PrimeRandomAudit.allocation: capacity-constrained Hamilton over sample stratum counts with base one per nonempty cell

digestContract.registrationHashSemantic: registrationHash is the frozen design registrationHash
digestContract.sampleSelectionContentRootHashSemantic: sampleSelectionContentRootHash excludes manifest timestamps and artifact self-hashes; it is not sampleManifestHash

algorithmDescriptor.selectionRegistrationHashSemantic: registrationHash is the frozen design registrationHash
algorithmDescriptor.selectionSampleContentRootSemantic: sampleSelectionContentRootHash excludes manifest timestamps and artifact self-hashes; it is not sampleManifestHash

providerRoleContractCatalog.fieldPresenceContract: FROZEN_FIELD_PRESENCE_V4: optional review fields use exactly {presence:MISSING}, {presence:NULL}, or {presence:PRESENT,value:<original runtime value>}; MISSING means absent in the frozen runtime item and must never be imputed. A multiple-choice item with missing options remains reviewable as a potential defect, not an input-format failure.

providerControls.priceRatePolicy: Current provider/region snapshot is self-hashed, finite, nonnegative, reasoning tokens are a subset of completion tokens, and worst-case cost plus 20 percent buffer is recomputed before authorization.
providerControls.authorizationSeparation: Qwen and DeepSeek grants, tokens, attempts, successful calls, and USD caps are separate and nontransferable.
providerControls.attemptGraphPolicy: Every complete run validates the exact ordered itemHash+role successful-call graph; empty, missing, duplicated, extra best-of-N, cross-item, or unauthorized role calls fail closed.

crossArtifactIntegrity.referenceSeal: Recompute all 60 full A/B solve+label bundles, conditional deterministic merge or one adjudication, full Qwen authorization and 240..300 successful-call graph, no extra best-of-N, item leaf hashes, seal roots, and agreement statistics.
crossArtifactIntegrity.deepSeekExecution: Recompute every B-prime and selected C0 role request/response/output/attempt, exact item lineage, complete marker, 60 item results, 120+5*|C0| call graph, tokens, costs, latency, and provider tuple.
crossArtifactIntegrity.finalEvaluation: Recompute observed and counterfactual ledgers, one-to-one finding matching, exactly eleven metric outputs, Wilson/bootstrap/worst-case conservative bounds, unified nonresolved integrity, final decision, and every aggregate/root.

examples: 57 complete + 3 missing + 0 unresolved + 0 invalid is integrity-valid

independentReview.a11Scope: Independent read-only recomputation from complete protected raw leaves; no primary scorer import and no hash-summary-only concurrence.
independentReview.a18Scope: Taxonomy, adjudication, severity, P0/P1/P2 interpretation, and claim wording only; not human gold-label review.
independentReview.reviewConsistencyPrerequisite: A11 CONCURRED and A18 NO_OBJECTION for the exact active design/execution/latest-final/review-ledger roots; this is necessary but does not authorize publication without an independently trusted custody registry.
